rachel: Quick sync 1 024 - planning hands-on SI enablement clinics for Q2. Goal: certify 12 partners with Bronze/Silver badges and publish marketplace listing. Thoughts on schedule + hardware access?
sam: Love it. Suggest 3 half-day clinics (APAC, NA, EMEA) + one gated on-prem lab day for Dedicated partners. Need HW loaner list from hardware team.
priya: We should split content: Day 1 infra + onboarding playbook, Day 2 deep dive on model routing and failover, Day 3 evals & cert. Make labs focused on common SI tasks (deploy, rollback, perf tuning).
enrique: For hardware loans, ask partners to cover shipping insurance. Also require an NDA form for early access to private deploy package. Can we add a quick checkbox in the marketplace intake?
rachel: Yes to both. Priya, can you draft the lab tasks? Sam, can you capture HW SKU list and shipping rules? I'll own marketplace intake change.
priya: Draft tasks (short):
- deploy-redwood-private (30m): config + KMS stub
- dedicated-scale-test (45m): simulate bursts with loadgen
- route-fallback-demo (20m): policy rules + simulated failover
- eval-regression (40m): run prompt-set and compare metrics
I'll add step-by-step commands & expected outputs.
sam: HW SKU shortlist: A100-40GB (loan), T4-small (dev), NVLink-cable kits. Shipping notes: 2-week loan max, damage deposit required. I'll open a vendor ticket.
rachel: Marketplace intake change: add fields -> "requires_hw_loan", "nda_signed", "cert_track". Also add UI flag for "is_dedicated_si" to control proctoring level.
enrique: Certification rubric proposal (short):
- Bronze: lab tasks complete + auto checks; badge issued
- Silver: Bronze + live walkthrough with SE + 2 sample infra runs
- Gold: Silver + production pilot with SLA + reference call
rachel: Perfect. Can we run a pilot clinic next month with 4 SIs? If yes, enablement-bot please create project card and send invites.
enablement-bot: Project created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-SI-2022 "SI enablement clinic pilot". Calendar invites sent to tentative list.
priya: Action items: Iprimary: task writeups by Tue, Sam: HW ticket + vendor outreach by Wed, Rachel: marketplace intake PR by Fri.
sam: Noted. Also logging: include telemetry tags in labs: si_cohort, hw_loan_id, cert_level. Helps post-mortem and billing.
rachel: Great call. We'll iterate on the rubric after pilot. Thanks all. :rocket:
